description: alcor's browser (fleet.md R102): each session drives its own Chrome window, its seat. One viewer shows them all.

functions.name: seat_open
functions.description: Attach this session to its own browser window. A trusted session gets Tony's profile unless it asks for a blank one. A cooperative session always gets a blank one. Returns the seat id.

params.name: own_container
params.description: Run this seat in its own container.

functions.name: seat_close
functions.description: Close this seat's window, tabs and container.

params.name: seat
params.description: The seat id that seat_open returned.

functions.name: tab_open
functions.description: Open a tab in this seat's window.

params.name: seat
params.description: The seat id that seat_open returned.

functions.name: tab_close
functions.description: Close a tab of this seat.

params.name: seat
params.description: The seat id that seat_open returned.

params.name: tab
params.description: A tab id of this seat's window.

functions.name: tab_activate
functions.description: Switch to a tab of this seat.

params.name: seat
params.description: The seat id that seat_open returned.

params.name: tab
params.description: A tab id of this seat's window.

params.name: seat
params.description: The seat id that seat_open returned.

functions.name: navigate
functions.description: Load a URL in a tab of this seat.

params.name: seat
params.description: The seat id that seat_open returned.

params.name: tab
params.description: A tab id of this seat's window.

functions.name: cdp
functions.description: Run a page-level DevTools method on a tab of this seat. Target, Browser, Storage and cookie-wide methods are refused.

params.name: seat
params.description: The seat id that seat_open returned.

params.name: tab
params.description: A tab id of this seat's window.

functions.name: screenshot
functions.description: A PNG of a tab, base64.

params.name: seat
params.description: The seat id that seat_open returned.

params.name: tab
params.description: A tab id of this seat's window.

functions.name: signin
functions.description: Ask Tony to pass a captcha or sign in on this seat's window. Files a request on the approvals queue and raises the window in the viewer.

params.name: seat
params.description: The seat id that seat_open returned.

functions.name: viewer
functions.description: The one viewer that shows every window. Starts the shared Chrome when it is stopped.

functions.name: service_cdp
functions.description: Run a page-level DevTools method on the site's tab in the service window, opening the tab first. Only the productivity service may call it.

params.name: site
params.description: A site the browser config names, such as slack, teams or discord.

functions.name: service_close
functions.description: Close the site's tab in the service window. Only the productivity service may call it.

params.name: site
params.description: A site the browser config names, such as slack, teams or discord.
